info.name: AgTrack Local API - Complete Testing Flow
info.description: Run once in order, one iteration. Registration generates new phone numbers. Creates persistent sample records on the selected API. Tests include expected 401,403,404,409,422 responses. No admin credentials required. Start the backend first. Use collection variables and remove environment variables that shadow them.
